added_lines: Visual Artists Listowel Fine Art & Craft Fair featuring unique locally hand- crafted items; artwork, prints, bespoke jewellery, textiles, sculpture and festive decorations. All available in St. Johns Theatre & Arts Centre, Listowel, Sunday 29th Nov. 10am-4pm. Tea, coffee, mulled wine and more. Everyone welcome. "Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat | 11th-13th December 2026 Calling all young people aged 16 –35! Join us at the Youth 2000 Christmas Retreat in Newbridge College, Co. Kildare. This is a donation-only event, with free buses available across the country and all meals included. Expect inspiring talks and workshops, Mass, music, prayer, and plenty of opportunities to chill out and meet other young Catholics. Whether you are new to the faith or looking to be refreshed, all are welcome. To register or find out more, visit youth2000.ie or follow @Youth2000Ireland." Moyvane
